svg.aria-label: Animated intro: Chippy connects your coding agent to the running React page through React's DevTools hook, traces a button to its component, owners, and source line, runs experiments on live state, separates a slow click's trigger from the busiest component, and shows the browser scripts, local helper, and agent skill working as one system.
svg.title: Chippy: the page is the witness

g.text: Code says what your app can do.
› Where does the “Approve” label come from?
Not a bot clicking through your browser.
deeper than DevTools, on your command.
Not an agent driving a browser. Each part does one job, and does it well.
for building, profiling, and understanding React.
